01-cover: OTC trading on Sui today forces a brutal trade-off. Post on a DEX and the mempool front-runs your size. Call a desk and trust them with the spread. Sealed Pair is a third option.
02-problem: DEXes leak. Mempool sees your order before it fills, slippage takes the rest. OTC desks ghost. They see the spread. And try proving to your DAO what you agreed to — the paper trail sits off-chain if it exists at all.
03-shape: Maker encrypts the terms locally and uploads the ciphertext to Walrus. The blob ID is the cryptographic commitment. A sealed quote hits the public RFQ board. Taker funds a refundable escrow on Sui. Key auto-releases. Atomic transaction settles both legs.
04-why: We surveyed every Sui Overflow project. Plenty use one of these primitives. Nobody combines commit-reveal, plus Seal-style selective disclosure, plus Walrus content addressing, plus atomic settlement, for OTC. This is the gap we filled.
05-tatum: Fourteen distinct Sui RPC methods through the Tatum gateway. Three networks auto-switching. Four Tatum products wired end-to-end. Sixty-nine millisecond median latency, probed live every thirty seconds.
06-walrus: The insight: blob ID is the BLAKE2b hash of the ciphertext. Storing it on-chain turns Walrus from a CDN into a content-addressed cryptographic commitment. Swap the bytes anywhere, and the commitment provably breaks.
07-shipped: Forty features in fourteen days. Solo build. Seventy plus QA findings across eleven rounds, all patched. Five Move transactions wired live. Two settled trades on-chain right now.
08-mcp: Tatum's official MCP ships ten Blockchain Data tools across twenty plus chains, but Sui is not one of them yet. Our four Sui-native MCP tools fill that gap. Compose both servers — an AI agent gets first-class Sui plus twenty-two other chains in one config.
09-judge: Mapped to every judging weight. Walrus and Tatum integration. Technical quality. Creativity. Presentation. Targeted at both bonus prizes: Best Walrus Integration and Best Use of Tatum Tools.
10-cta: Stop trusting the desk. Sealed Pair. Private quotes. Public settlement. On Sui.
demo-01-landing: Sealed Pair landing page. Live at sealed-pair dot vercel dot app. The hero spells out the trade-off: move size without tipping your hand.
demo-02-board: The RFQ board. Twenty five plus real on-chain orders polled every thirty seconds via Tatum's gateway. Every order is a real Sui object. Every blob ID is a real Walrus blob.
demo-03-pair: Pair depth widget — aggregated from live OrderPosted events. Sui dollars, dollars Sui, WAL pairs, all sized live.
demo-04-deal: Click any order — deal room. The terms are sealed. The Walrus blob is the commitment. Fund escrow and the key auto-releases.
demo-05-vault: The Vault — two settled trades, on-chain. Each settled row has a real digest, clickable to SuiScan. Live contract introspection below proves the Move package is deployed.
demo-06-mcp: And the MCP catalog. Four read-only tools any AI agent can call. Fills the Sui-native gap Tatum's own MCP doesn't yet cover.
demo-07-end: Sealed Pair. Built with Tatum and Walrus. On Sui. Source on GitHub.
